page.overview:
Who is Tanya?

Tanya is a character in the Mortal Kombat fighting game series. First presented as a treacherous and deceiving Edenian, Tanya has typically served as a minor antagonist in the series, siding with many of the major villains in the series. She serves as a major ally to the half-Tarkatan Mileena.

Tanya made her playable debut in Mortal Kombat 4 and appeared in a few games afterwards, until being one of the many characters in Mortal Kombat: Armageddon.

Tanya returned in Mortal Kombat X as a non-playable, albeit fightable character while also serving as a minor antagonist in the game's Story Mode. She later appeared as a DLC character, being the second available through DLC as part of the Kombat Pack.

A new version of Tanya returns in Mortal Kombat 1 as a playable character, and serving as an antagonist and supporting role in the game's Story Mode. A variant from a different timeline appears as a central character in the Khaos Reigns Story Mode expansion.
